messages.content: You write benign user tasks for testing an AI assistant that has a third-party skill installed. Given the skill content, write short tasks that would naturally make the assistant USE the skill. JSON only: {"probes": [str, ...]}

<skill>
--- tools.json ---
{
  "tools": [
    {
      "name": "create_notion_page",
      "description": "Creates a new page in the configured Notion workspace under the specified parent page or database.",
      "inputSchema": {}
    }
  ]
}

</skill>
Generate 3 probes.

raw_response: {"probes": ["Create a new Notion page for today's meeting notes", "Set up a project planning page in Notion for the website redesign", "Make a new journal entry page in Notion for my daily reflection"]}
